help.card.desc: There are cards from 1 to 10, each available in 10 copies.
help.end.desc:
The game ends when all cards have been revealed and played.

All orthogonally adjacent cards of the same value cancel each other out and are removed from the game.

Count the total value of all the cards still in your grid.
<bold>The lowest score wins the game.</bold>
help.firstplayer.desc:
Starting with the person in possession of the First Player counter, each player clockwise selects one of the cards revealed in the center of the table and inserts it into his or her grid from the outside.

At the end of the round, the First Player token passes to the person to the left of the current first player.
header.choose.me: You must choose a face-down card
header.choose.revealed.player: {player} must insert one of the cards in their grid
header.choose.revealed.me: Insert one of the cards into your grid
tuto.tableau:
In Slide, each player has <bold>16 cards</bold> in front of them, face down, forming a 4-card by 4-card grid.
This is your grid.
tuto.choose:
Each turn, you must choose a <bold>face-down</bold> card from your grid.
Choose this card.
tuto.simultaneous: All players reveal <bold>simultaneously</bold> the card they have chosen.
tuto.first:
Here's the <bold>First Player pawn</bold>.
It indicates who will begin choosing a card to place in their grid.
tuto.expl:
You are the first player for this round.
On your turn, you must choose one of the revealed cards and insert it into your grid.
tuto.insert:
To insert a card into your grid, it must push <bold>a row</bold> or <bold>a column</bold> to fill the empty space.
Here are the 3 possible locations this round.
tuto.play.1: Take this card and place it here.
tuto.first.change: Once all players have inserted a card, the first player passes to the neighbor on the left.
tuto.new:
A new round then begins. Each player must again choose a <bold>face-down</bold> card to reveal.
Choose this card.
tuto.opponent.first: Your opponent plays first this time.
tuto.play.2: It's up to you. Insert your card here.
tuto.end: In this way, 16 rounds are played, until all the cards are revealed.
tuto.goal:
Your aim is to place cards of the same value side by side.
At the end of the game, <bold>all adjacent cards of the same value cancel each other out</bold> and are removed from the deck.
tuto.score: The player with <bold>the fewest points</bold> by counting the total value of his remaining cards <bold>wins the game</bold>.
tuto.go: Now it's your turn to play, and good luck!
